result.summary: The page is mostly polished, but the bottom navigation shows an incorrect active state and the horizontal carousels have awkwardly clipped content at the right edge.

issues.description: The screen displays the home/discovery feed, but “Profile” is highlighted in green while “Home” is inactive. This makes the current navigation state misleading.
issues.suggestion: Mark “Home” as the active tab on this screen and reserve the green Profile state for the profile page.

issues.description: The category row and “Fastest near you” carousel end with heavily clipped items at the right edge. The category pill is especially awkward because only an empty sliver is visible.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card spacing, widths, or carousel padding so the next item is either meaningfully visible as a scroll cue or fully outside the viewport.
